scope_basis: Project modernises the tax administration's information systems, digital procedures and system security.
title: Projet d'appui à la modernisation des systèmes d'information (PAMSI) de la DGI du Bénin
description:
PAMSI accompanies Benin's Direction générale des impôts in its digital transformation, to improve the tax administration's efficiency, ease taxpayer procedures and strengthen domestic resource mobilisation. It sits under the Plan d'orientation stratégique de l'administration fiscale (POSAF), itself built on the recommendations of the TADAT (2021) and PEFA assessments, and works on three lines: better exploitation of tax data, including automated cross-matching and analysis of information from the DGI and partner administrations (customs, treasury, budget); extension of digitalised tax procedures, notably connecting the **29 tax centres** not yet on SIGIBé, plus electronic document management with probative-value archiving and a pre-filled tax return; and the performance, reliability and security of the DGI's information system, including operationalising its business-continuity and disaster-recovery plans.

Two figures the fiche states, both to be carried dated and attributed to it rather than as measured outcomes: a feasibility study puts the pre-filled return's potential at **331 billion FCFA a year** in additional domestic resources and a **40 percent** improvement in the TADAT score; and the information system's conformity with the Politique de sécurité des systèmes d'information de l'État béninois (PSSIE) is reported to have risen **from 30 percent to 81.6 percent**, with the remaining activities expected to add a further 6.8 points (as at 2026-08-20).

The project had six components: 1. Reinforcement of 2000 km of fiber optic cable called the ‘National Backbone’. 2. Modernizing a 230 km fiber optic cable line. 5. Creating 30 new 4G base stations. 6. Creating another IP Multimedia Subsystem core network. This project also involved the installation of 48 IP/MPLS routers to extend the IP BTS network. Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. was the contractor responsible for implementation.
